name: sticky-hero-section
title: Sticky Hero Section
description: A pale headline screen pinned in place shrinks and tips back while a dark second screen scales up and levels out over it, ending as a building gallery with four photos.
use: A landing page wants a dramatic hand-off from a headline screen to a content screen.
avoid: It is only two fixed screens with no props, and the four photos sit in a row that never wraps.
a11y: Photos use the placeholder alt text img, and the scale and rotate transforms ignore reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pale grey page with faint grid lines and a centred black headline, then a near-black screen with the same grid, a bold white heading and four architecture photos in a row. The two page edges meet at a slight angle while they overlap.
behaves: Scrolling down pulls the light screen to four fifths and rotates it back a few degrees while the dark screen grows from slightly small and straightens on top of it. At the end the dark gallery owns the viewport with the light page behind it.
customise: No props: both headlines, the subline, the four photos and the two colour gradients are written into the two sections in the file.
weight: light: Four remote photos and two scroll transforms on whole screens.
